integrity: The defining set, generator columns, published ordinary weight distribution, every subspace of \(\mathbb F_2^7\), complete intersection histograms, generalized Hamming weights, and extremal-subcode multiplicities are reconstructed with exact finite arithmetic by the bundled standalone verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the published binary \([28,7,12]_2\) representative. No equivalence-class identification among the four historical representatives is claimed, and no novelty is asserted for the generalized-weight values in isolation. Some older full text was not obtainable, leaving a residual risk of an unindexed equivalent minimizer count.
title: Exact extremal-subcode multiplicities for the Liu–Liu–Yu \([28,7,12]_2\) code
